description:
User approved 2026-11-24 for the end of the fz-9x7 epic (relayed by GC).

FromSpace::of / YoungRanges::of (runtime/src/heap/gc/from_space.rs:17) collects and sorts every young block's range on each minor collection.

Evidence, fanin on bench: the receiver runs 191 minor collections. Each releases about 4000 blocks (one per received message) and copies only 1-3 objects. Building and sorting the ranges costs 4.9 ms per run, and releasing the blocks costs 2.2 ms, together about 7% of the run. develop pays the same today.

Overlap: the sorted young-range Vec is one of the allocations fz-9x7.11.7 (C5, "A collection allocates nothing") removes. The builder (GC) may fold this ticket into .11.7 once the code shows the overlap.
title: A minor collection tells a young pointer from an old one without a sorted range table
